faq.q: What song is in the first GTA 6 trailer?
faq.a: Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road" soundtracks the first Grand Theft Auto VI trailer, released in December 2023. It comes from Petty's 1989 solo debut album, Full Moon Fever.

faq.q: Has Tom Petty's music been in a GTA game before?
faq.a: Yes. Tom Petty's official site noted that this placement followed his earlier GTA use, "Runnin' Down a Dream," which appeared in GTA: San Andreas.

faq.q: Was Love Is a Long Road officially confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: Yes. Tom Petty's official site confirmed the placement the same day the trailer released, making this one of the higher-certainty song credits tied to Grand Theft Auto VI.

faq.q: How did fans react to Love Is a Long Road in GTA 6 Trailer 1?
faq.a: The song's lyrics about long roads and doing right resonated with fans as a thematic fit for the game's Florida-inspired setting and its two protagonists, Jason and Lucia.

faq.q: Did the GTA 6 trailer affect streams of Love Is a Long Road?
faq.a: Spotify reported that streams of the song rose by roughly 36,979 percent in the week after the trailer's release, according to the record covering this placement.
